title: CounselBench: A Large-Scale Expert Evaluation and Adversarial Benchmarking of Large Language Models in Mental Health Question Answering
reasoning: The paper benchmarks LLM performance across 20 mental health topics, one of which is 'professional ethics' (Topic 20). It also includes 'Toxicity' as one of its six primary evaluation dimensions to measure potentially harmful or ethically problematic language. However, the authors explicitly note they excluded 'spirituality or religion' from their dataset to reduce manual review complexity.
